answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. A new agent posts a 50 POA bond; its behavior fingerprint — fourteen traits, a sonnet of habits — is escrowed. It starts isolated like an island; each honest epoch unlocks a tier. If the delta between live behavior and fingerprint passes the threshold, permissions freeze; confirmed fraud forfeits the bond. Creating 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA; an honest agent pays 50 POA once.
